final: WITH by_media AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM by_media) SELECT b.media_type, b.avg_ratio, b.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM by_media AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg
